import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mp
plt.xkcd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8,4))
ax.set_xlim(0,10); ax.set_ylim(0,5); ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')
ax.plot([0,10],[1,1],'k-',lw=2)
ax.text(0.2,0.6,'BP-1 bed')
ax.plot([3,5.5],[0.7,3.2],'k-',lw=3)
ax.plot([3.4,5.9],[0.9,3.4],'k-',lw=1)
ax.text(1.6,2.0,'bucket ladder 20deg entry')
for x,y in [(3.3,0.9),(3.9,1.5),(4.5,2.1),(5.1,2.7)]:
    ax.add_patch(mp.Rectangle((x,y),0.3,0.2,fill=False,lw=2))
ax.plot([5.9,7.5],[3.4,3.4],'k-',lw=2)
ax.plot([5.9,6.4],[3.4,2.0],'k-',lw=2)
ax.plot([7.5,7.0],[3.4,2.0],'k-',lw=2)
ax.text(6.0,3.6,'wedge hopper 20L')
ax.text(6.0,2.5,'gate + vibrator')
ax.add_patch(mp.Rectangle((7.8,0.0),1.5,1.5,fill=False,lw=2))
ax.text(7.9,0.5,'bin')
ax.annotate('dump pivot rear', xy=(7.0,2.0), xytext=(5.0,4.2), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->'))
ax.set_title('Excavation and dump side view')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('sketch.png')
